part: final-b days 11-15 (Jan 29 - Feb 2) plus Hokkaido items from days 9-10 (Rusutsu drift + licence, Rusutsu lesson/ticket, Rhythm rental, Hotel 3M, Toyota CTS car), flights home from Narita, bookFirst

issues.problem: The Introduction Course (30 min, ¥31,000) runs only in the 15:00 slot; at 08:30/10:00/13:00 the only self-drive option is the 75-min Driving Course at ¥61,000 (rear seat ¥20,000).
issues.fix: Book the Introduction Course at 15:00 (ends 15:30, back in Kutchan about 16:15, sunset 16:42) and do the pro ride in the same slot; use the morning for skiing. Or keep 10:00 and pay ¥61,000 for the Driving Course.

issues.problem: The page only asks for a driving licence (no minimum years, no IDP rule named), 17:00 day-before booking, prepayment, and a 10% cancel fee from the moment you book.
issues.fix: Keep the plan's step: email activity@rusutsu.co.jp before booking to confirm a Canadian licence of about 1 year + IDP is accepted. Book only after the reply, because the 10% fee starts at booking.

issues.problem: Rusutsu's 2026-27 international school lists only private lessons (2 h 14:00-16:00 = ¥51,000; 3 h 13:30-16:30 = ¥61,000); there is no adult group lesson.
issues.fix: Drop the Rusutsu lesson (Pegasis teaches Aoki on the easy runs) or budget ¥51,000 for a 2-h private; bookings open early October.

issues.problem: 2026-27 regular season: 5-hour ticket ¥14,500 at the counter (¥11,600 online), 1-day ¥16,700 (¥13,200 online); no cheap afternoon ticket.
issues.fix: Budget ¥11,600 per person (5-hour ticket bought online), or skip Rusutsu skiing and ski only at Annupuri/Hirafu.

issues.problem: Niseko Annupuri Snow School (the Annupuri school) offers only private lessons: 2 h at 10:00-12:00 or 13:30-15:30, ¥40,000 for 1 person / ¥45,000 for 2; English 'may not be possible in busy season'.
issues.fix: Book one NISS adult group lesson in English at Hanazono (10:00-15:30, ¥32,000 in regular season Jan 4-Feb 5, max 4 people) instead of two short lessons, or budget ¥40,000 for a 2-h Annupuri private. Correct the cost line '2 lessons ≈ ¥20,000'.

issues.problem: Hirafu/Hanazono peak season (Dec 24-Feb 28) has only an afternoon 4-hour ticket from 12:00 (¥8,400 online / ¥8,900); a morning skier must buy the 1-day H/H ticket ¥11,800 online / ¥12,500.
issues.fix: Budget ¥11,800 each (online 1-day Hirafu & Hanazono) or the all-mountain 12-point ticket ¥7,500 if you ride only a few lifts; or ski the Annupuri 5-hour ticket (¥6,700) instead.

issues.problem: For Jan 27-30 (3 nights, 2 adults) Jalan shows only a smoking twin at ¥69,000 (≈ ¥23,000/night, 2 rooms left) or a non-smoking single + extra bed ¥60,000; the plan says ≈ ¥49,500.
issues.fix: Book now (refundable) and raise the hotel budget by about ¥15,000-20,000; ask for a non-smoking room. Free car park (20 cars, first come), check-out 10:00, confirmed.

issues.item: Route Inn Sapporo Chuo, Sat Jan 30
issues.problem: Jalan has no twin left for Sat Jan 30 (only 1 semi-double ¥20,700); Jan 31 twin is ¥14,800.
issues.fix: Book Jan 30 now on the official Route Inn site or Rakuten; if no twin, take a nearby twin (e.g. Comfort Hotel Sapporo Susukino) for Jan 30 or both nights. Do not wait until mid-October.

issues.item: Route Inn car park for the 4WD
issues.problem: Parking is a paid tower car park (86 spaces, first come, no reservation) that refuses cars with roof carriers or spare tyres on the back.
issues.fix: Rent a car without a roof ski carrier (skis are already returned on Jan 30), and have a coin car park near Susukino as a backup.

issues.problem: GARAKU Sapporo main shop is now at Minami 3-jo Higashi 2-chome B1F (east of Sosei River), not near Tanukikoji 2-chome as in the plan coordinates; about 15 min on foot from the hotel. Hours 17:00-21:00 dinner, irregular closing days.
issues.fix: Update the place to 札幌市中央区南3条東2丁目6-1 (about 43.0577, 141.3605) and the walks to 15 min (hotel → GARAKU) and 10 min (GARAKU → Maidreamin).

issues.item: Mt Moiwa sunset after the car return
issues.problem: Sunset in Sapporo on Jan 31 is about 16:43; leaving Toyota Sapporo-ekimae at 15:50, subway + streetcar + 15-min shuttle + 15-min ropeway gets you to the top about 16:50-17:00, after sunset. Ropeway winter hours 11:00-22:00, ¥2,100 confirmed.
issues.fix: Take a taxi from the Toyota shop to the ropeway base (about 15 min, ≈ ¥2,000), or leave Asahikawa 20 min earlier; the night view after 17:10 is still fine.

issues.problem: Zoo is open Jan 31, 2027 10:30-15:30 (last entry 15:00) and entry is ¥1,000 until Apr 28, 2027, but the 2026-27 penguin walk times are not published yet (they start only when there is enough snow).
issues.fix: Check the zoo site in early January for the walk times (usually 11:00 and 14:30); if only 14:30, eat ramen first and see the walk at 14:30, which still fits the 16:00 car return.

issues.item: Hotel → Sapporo Station on foot with bags
issues.problem: The Route Inn is at Minami 5-jo Nishi 5 (Susukino), about 1.8 km / 25 min on snowy pavement to JR Sapporo Station, so '50 min' to the airport is too short on foot.
issues.fix: Take the Namboku subway Susukino → Sapporo (2 stops, 3 min) and catch a Rapid Airport around 08:30; leave the hotel at 08:10.

issues.problem: The Airport Limousine site blocks access from this network, so the timetable and the ≈ ¥1,400 fare were not confirmed; arriving at the hotel at 13:45 and at Shibuya Sky by 14:59 is tight.
issues.fix: If the bus after 12:40 is late, go by Keikyu + JR Yamanote to Shibuya directly with the bags and use a coin locker (bags are not allowed on the roof anyway).

issues.problem: The 15:00-17:25 Air China nonstop exists on Feb 2, 2027, but Google Flights shows 'price unavailable' today; the cheapest bookable nonstop is Spring 19:40 → 22:35 at CA$418.
issues.fix: Check airchina.com directly; if no fare, book Spring 19:40 (Narita T3, not T1) and let Aoki take a later bus with Pegasis.

ok: Rusutsu drift: operating mid-Dec 2026 to late Feb 2027, slots 08:30/10:00/13:00/15:00, pro ride Subaru B4 ¥17,000 each for 1-2 people, GT-R/GR Yaris ¥27,000, booking by 17:00 the day before, breath test, desk shuttle (https://rusutsu.com/en/winter-activities/snow-driving/)

Asahiyama Zoo open Jan 31, 2027 10:30-15:30, ¥1,000 (price rises only from Apr 29, 2027) (https://www.city.asahikawa.hokkaido.jp/asahiyamazoo/event/event.html)
